CCT_EDGE / PFC_EDGE Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 9, 2026

Overview

This application does not collect, store, transmit, or process any personally identifiable information (PII). No user accounts, registration, or login is required. Scenario content stays on the server and is never sent to your browser.

Data We Do Not Collect

We do not collect names, email addresses, IP addresses, device identifiers, cookies, usage analytics, or any other information that could identify an individual user.

Data Processing

Input submitted to this application is processed transiently to generate a report and is not retained after the session ends. No input or output data is logged, stored, or shared with third parties for any purpose other than generating the requested output.

Third-Party Services

This application relies on the following third-party services:

  • Render — Application hosting. Render may collect server-level operational data (e.g., request logs) as part of infrastructure operation. See Render’s Privacy Policy.
  • OpenAI — AI model inference (model gpt-5.4). Input submitted to this application is processed by OpenAI’s API to generate output. OpenAI’s data handling practices govern that processing. See OpenAI’s Privacy Policy.

Neither service receives data from this application beyond what is technically necessary for request handling.

Cookies

This application does not use cookies or similar tracking technologies.

Children’s Privacy

This application does not target or knowingly interact with children under 13.

GDPR (European Economic Area Users)

This application does not collect personal data as defined under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Because no personal data is collected or processed by this application, no legal basis for processing is required and no data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection) are applicable at the application level. Users in the EEA who have concerns about data processed by third-party infrastructure providers (Render, OpenAI) should refer to those providers’ respective GDPR disclosures.

CCPA (California Residents)

This application does not collect personal information as defined under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). No personal information is sold, shared, or disclosed to third parties for commercial purposes. California residents therefore have no data subject rights to exercise against this application. Any data processed by third-party providers is governed by their respective CCPA disclosures.

Changes to This Policy

This policy may be updated periodically. Continued use of the application after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

Contact

For questions about this policy, contact: prolonged.sim@gmail.com
